'''Joelin''' was a member of the [[Children of the Light]].

==Activities==

He came to the [[Two Rivers]] under the command of [[Dain Bornhald]].

He was killed in a "skirmish with [[Trollocs]]" while in a group commanded by [[Ordeith]]. This is the second time that Dain sent his own men with Ordeith and his band of followers and the second time his men were the only fatalities. Dain suspects they were murdered.
